name: The 28th Annual Macro Conference
organizer: Macro Conference program committee (University of Tokyo, Keio, Hitotsubashi, Nagoya); hosted by Hitotsubashi University
submission_requirements: Paper (English or Japanese) in PDF via Google Form, naming two preferred discussants; a 10-page abstract is acceptable (full paper then due 30 Oct 2026). Priority to young researchers and graduate students when quality is comparable. Audience may ask questions in Japanese. Travel and accommodation covered for presenters, discussants and chairs (possibly not for travel from abroad).
contact: Program committee: Kosuke Aoki (Tokyo), Yasuo Hirose (Keio), Ryo Jinnai (Hitotsubashi), Takayuki Tsuruga (Nagoya)
